Growth shows stronger sales, but the release does not provide a prior-period revenue amount.
Operating profit contrasts with the net loss, indicating that costs below operating profit remain significant.
The loss improved year on year, but remains substantial; no prior-period amount was provided.

Faster growth in non-airline businesses may diversify revenue, though the release gives no segment profit.

This is an operating and financial recovery update showing revenue growth alongside a continuing net loss and fuel-cost pressure. Further improvement in earnings and evidence that fleet and non-airline growth translate into sustained profitability would make the recovery a larger catalyst.
